raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A storage prefetch that the stop policy ends before the read completes is not a storage shortfall: the span is still in the store, and the hit count the query agreed on may be a MIN over lookups that were skipped rather than a verdict about what is stored. A partial hybrid transfer is nevertheless resolved as `storage_transfer`, which heals the storage-existence beliefs beyond the completed span, so the next insert re-writes pages the store already holds and lookups skip them until it does.

## Modifications

- `PrefetchOperation.deadline_expired` marks an operation whose read was ended by the stop policy. `_handle_prefetch_result` then reports the unfulfilled tokens under a new `deadline` reason and leaves the KV and auxiliary-pool beliefs untouched; `_invalidate_absent_from_hit_query` skips such a cut query. The flag is set by a cache or controller implementation that cancels an in-flight read under its stop policy; the in-tree `timeout` check in `check_prefetch_progress` keeps its current handling in this PR.
- `storage_prefetch_unfulfilled_tokens` gains the `deadline` reason label, pre-registered like the others.
- `PrefillAdder` finishes storage-prefetch admission for a retracted request (with `reason=None`, so nothing is logged) after discarding its accounting, so a cache implementation that keeps per-request admission state sees the same lifecycle end as every other admitted request. In the base cache this call is a no-op for that request because its accounting was already discarded. `test_prefill_adder.py` asserts the call.
- The buffer-mode hit-drain fixture in `test_storage_prefetch_lifecycle.py` gains `deadline_expired=False`, since the drain now reads it.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no change to model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the change only affects how a cut prefetch is attributed and whether its storage beliefs are healed.

Unit tests run locally on this head:

- `test/registered/unit/managers/test_prefill_adder.py`: 52 passed, 49 subtests passed
- `test_storage_prefetch_lifecycle.py` + `test_hicache_pp_sync_drain.py`: 14 passed, 10 subtests passed
- `test_buffer_mode_sidecar.py`, `test_unified_hicache_transfer_lifecycle.py`, `test_pp_prefetch_ticket.py`, `test_unified_radix_cache_unittest.py`: 1370 passed, 1555 skipped (no GPU-dependent cases run); the 5 failures seen locally (`TestSwaLoadBackReservation`, `TestLoadBackAdmission`, `TestWritePolicySwitch`, `test_ledgers_count_reclaimable_tokens`) fail identically on upstream main in this environment (pinned-host-memory / CUDA stream errors) and are unrelated to this change

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
